verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
lines: to know wisdom and instruction;
to discern the words of understanding;

verses.text: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
lines: to receive instruction in wise dealing,
in righteousness, justice, and equity;

verses.text: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
lines: to give prudence to the simple,
knowledge and discretion to the young man:

verses.text: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
lines: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:

verses.text: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
lines: to understand a proverb, and parables,
the words and riddles of the wise.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
lines: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge;
but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.text: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
lines: My son, listen to your father’s instruction,
and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:

verses.text: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
lines: for they will be a garland to grace your head,
and chains around your neck.

verses.text: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
lines: My son, if sinners entice you,
don’t consent.

verses.text: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
lines: If they say, “Come with us.
Let’s lay in wait for blood.
Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

verses.text: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
lines: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol,
and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

verses.text: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
lines: We’ll find all valuable wealth.
We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

verses.text: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
lines: You shall cast your lot among us.
We’ll all have one purse.”

verses.text: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
lines: My son, don’t walk on the path with them.
Keep your foot from their path,

verses.text: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
lines: for their feet run to evil.
They hurry to shed blood.

verses.text: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
lines: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

verses.text: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
lines: but these lay in wait for their own blood.
They lurk secretly for their own lives.

verses.text: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
lines: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain.
It takes away the life of its owners.

verses.text: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
lines: Wisdom calls aloud in the street.
She utters her voice in the public squares.

verses.text: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
lines: She calls at the head of noisy places.
At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

verses.text: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
lines: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity?
How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery,
and fools hate knowledge?

verses.text: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
lines: Turn at my reproof.
Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you.
I will make known my words to you.

verses.text: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
lines: Because I have called, and you have refused;
I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

verses.text: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
lines: but you have ignored all my counsel,
and wanted none of my reproof;

verses.text: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
lines: I also will laugh at your disaster.
I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

verses.text: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
lines: when calamity overtakes you like a storm,
when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind,
when distress and anguish come on you.

verses.text: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
lines: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer.
They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;

verses.text: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
lines: because they hated knowledge,
and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

verses.text: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
lines: They wanted none of my counsel.
They despised all my reproof.

verses.text: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
lines: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way,
and be filled with their own schemes.

verses.text: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
lines: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them.
The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

verses.text: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
lines: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely,
and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
